answer: In PoA, each bonded identity is an escrowed liability: when k identities coordinate equivocation, correlated evidence makes the penalty grow quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Upon detection, a sybil swarm also incurs an exponential multiplier in capital loss across linked escrows, making concealment economically irrational. An attacker cannot wander toward the nadir or hide behind a jetty of cheap aliases.
